goal: Complete Grade IX and X Punjab-board aligned Question Bank with original MCQs, short, long and applicable grammar/language items, dual-medium support where academically appropriate, verified provenance and Paper Generator compatibility.

scopePolicy.primary: All current Grade IX/X subjects represented in the verified PECTAA catalog manifest, plus IX-X grammar/general-science supplements, while expanding the manifest for any school-offered Humanities/Arts/Matric-Tech/religious-alternative subject before claiming final completion.
scopePolicy.copyrightPolicy: Generate original questions from verified concepts; do not reproduce textbook passages or protected paper wording except minimal labels/references.

authorities.grade9Pattern2026: PECTAA Revised Smart Syllabus / Pairing Schemes / Model Papers notification 07.11.2025; use pattern as assessment evidence while keeping full-book bank coverage.
